text:
Type: long wooden dining bench
Use: seating along a dining table, extra seating against a wall; dining room, kitchen, hallway
Style: minimalist, contemporary, Scandinavian
Materials: wood with a visible open grain, dark stained matte finish
Colors: black-brown, dark espresso
Shape: long flat seat with a narrow groove down the middle, deep apron, four thick square legs, crisp straight lines, long and low, medium visual weight
Feel: solid, grounded, sleek, calm
Goes with: dark wood dining tables, white or grey walls, black or brass accents; modern, minimalist or Scandinavian dining rooms

product.name: BJURSTA
product.description: The clear-lacquered surface is easy to wipe clean.
